479:t_1:86.en:
$$葵$$
「Or would you rather do it for real?」

479:t_1:88.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$葵$$... She's just like $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

479:t_1:92.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「This fire in our blood, welling up from deep within us...」

479:t_1:93.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「It's hot... And yet, so sweet...」

479:t_1:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Has all of $$チームＤ$$ gone crazy?!」

479:t_1:96.en:
$$くらら$$
「No, $$ノノ$$. None of us has gone crazy.」

479:t_1:97.en:
$$朔哉$$
「This is who we really are.」

479:t_1:98.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「We may act cool, but there's a beast sleeping inside each of us.」

479:t_1:99.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「It's waking up, and it's about to envelop us.」

479:t_1:104.en: ～$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$　Command Room～

479:t_1:105.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Do you think their battle with $$竜馬$$ caused this?」

479:t_1:107.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「$$ゲッター線$$ has the power to make living things evolve... And they fought $$竜馬$$, whose instincts it had stimulated...」

479:t_1:108.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「That probably stimulated $$チームＤ$$'s instincts as well.」

479:t_1:109.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Will they be all right...? We'll be in trouble if they turn into savage beasts, too.」

479:t_1:110.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Humans are beasts, too... But humans are not savages.」

479:t_1:111.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Humans transcend the beast... And eventually grow into warriors of God...」

479:t_1:112.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Normally, 'they' were supposed to show us the way...」

479:t_1:114.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「They were not on $$翠の地球$$, either... It seems they were sent to a universe even my power cannot detect.」

479:t_1:115.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So there, they will awaken the beast within a humanity that has ceased to advance...」

479:t_1:116.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Their displacement may have been the will of the universe.」

479:t_1:118.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They truly are warriors of God.」

479:t_1:119.en:
$$田中司令$$
「And the fact that they left must mean their mission here is already complete.」

479:t_1:122.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We are probably their target.」

479:t_1:123.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then we shall meet them. Order everyone to sortie.」

479:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Still, that $$エルーナルーナ$$ is tough. No wonder she's after $$ランド$$.」

479:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But thanks to her, we have confirmed that Miss $$スズネ$$ is safe for now.」

479:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add the 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s born from the mingling of $n's hope and $$エルーナルーナ$$'s desire to our reserves.」

479:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But this is hardly the time to be acting so relaxed...!」

479:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies! As you can see, things are rather hectic at the moment!」

479:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I must postpone our celebration for our ace pilots until next time!」

479:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! Rest assured, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business as usual!」

479:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that! Even in a crisis... Business is business!」

480:t_000:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Sounds good, doesn't it? $$ガンレオン$$ is a lion, too.」

480:t_000:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh! I'm joining $$チームＤ$$, too?!」

480:t_000:4.en:
$$くらら$$
「Sorry. We already have a lion.」

480:t_000:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't be so uptight! Let's combine into $$ガンダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッドレオン・マグナ$$!」

480:t_000:7.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That hot-blooded attitude of yours... I think you and us cool types would mix like oil and water.」

480:t_000:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Besides, we already have our comic relief.」

480:t_000:9.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hold on, $$ジョニー$$! What's that supposed to mean?!」

480:t_000:10.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Huh... You don't get it?」

480:t_000:11.en:
$$くらら$$
「Would you like me to spell it out?」

480:t_000:13.en:
$$メール$$
「Yep! $$朔哉$$ is doing his job!」

480:t_000:14.en:
$$葵$$
「His job, huh... In that sense, $$ランド$$ might be just the partner I need right now.」

480:t_000:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sure. Go ahead and lean on me.」

480:t_000:16.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I won't hold back. You look like you could take it, no matter how wild I get.」

480:t_000:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「You... really are getting more like $$エルーナルーナ$$...」

480:t_000:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「She's just like $$竜馬$$ was the other day.」

480:t_000:20.en:
$n
「Then was $$葵$$ exposed to $$ゲッター線$$, too?」

480:t_000:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Why are you surprised now? $$ゲッター線$$ rains down on Earth all the time.」

480:t_000:22.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then will we turn out like you and $$葵$$, too?!」

480:t_000:23.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$. People with self-control don't end up like that.」

480:t_000:24.en:
$$弁慶$$
「That's right. That only happens to people with a beast in their hearts.」

480:t_000:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then I'm fine! All I've got inside me is a growling stomach!」

480:t_000:26.en:
$$勝平$$
「I've got one of those, too!」

480:t_000:27.en:
$$柿小路$$
「...So they say. $$郁絵$$, prepare snacks for the President and the others once the battle is over.」

480:t_000:29.en:
$n
「I should've mentioned my growling stomach, too.」

480:t_000:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「You've stopped looking like you've bitten into something bitter, at least.」

480:t_000:33.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Do you have some bitter memories?」

480:t_000:34.en:
$$ランド$$
「...That talk about already having a lion reminded me of someone...」

480:t_000:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「He piloted a lion-shaped machine, too. In a way, he wore all his desires on his sleeve.」
